note: De-duplicated list of field births and combinations: seed sets A and B, the four period runs and the open harvests, merged by seven AI matching passes over overlapping year windows. `also` lists the entries merged into each. Umbrella events and their sub-milestones were kept apart. Not human-checked except the audit sample (audit: true). Dates may be numeric ranges or free text.

events.name: Archimedes' mechanical method for areas and volumes
events.datesNote: The Method is undated; placed within Archimedes' lifetime.
events.why: Balancing figures on a lever (centres of gravity) is used to discover area and volume results later proved by exhaustion.

events.name: Algebra as a discipline (al-Khwarizmi)
events.datesNote: Whether this is the birth of algebra or a stage in it is the standard historiographic dispute; Diophantus and Babylonian procedures precede it.
events.why: Problem-solving with unknowns is organised around a small set of normal-form equations with systematic geometric justification, giving algebra its own objects and rules.

events.name: The calculus
events.datesNote: Tangent and quadrature methods (Cavalieri, Fermat, Barrow) and infinite series (Mercator, Newton) are unified by the inverse relation; institutional end-point is Euler's Introductio (1748) centring functions.
events.why: Tangent, quadrature and series techniques are unified into an algorithm with a notation, with the inverse relation between differentiation and integration as its core.

events.name: Graph theory from the Konigsberg bridges
events.datesNote: Euler's paper is a one-off for a century; Kirchhoff (1847) and Cayley/Sylvester (1870s) give tools; Konig's 1936 textbook is the institutional marker.

events.datesNote: Euler's product over the primes (1737); Dirichlet's characters and L-series prove primes in arithmetic progressions (read 1837, French version 1839). The complex-analytic phase is E61.
events.why: Infinite series and characters of finite abelian groups (a Fourier analysis on Z/nZ) are used to count primes in residue classes.

events.name: Algebraic topology: Betti numbers to homology groups

events.name: Prismatic cohomology

events.name: Cobordism hypothesis

events.name: Higher-order Fourier analysis

events.name: Smirnov conformal invariance
events.why: Smirnov proved conformal invariance of critical Ising and percolation using discrete holomorphicity.
works: Smirnov, Conformal invariance in random cluster models I, Annals 2010, arXiv:0708.0039
events.basis: Found by a MacTutor/SEP or Quanta/blogs harvest and a Wikipedia harvest (period 1990-2026); judged real by an AI verifier. events.name: Local Langlands for GL_n
to: representation theory of p-adic groups (local Langlands)

Henniart, Une preuve simple des conjectures de Langlands pour GL(n), Invent. 2000

events.name: Sensitivity conjecture

works: Huang, Induced subgraphs of hypercubes and a proof of the Sensitivity Conjecture, Annals 2019 (arXiv:1907.00847)
events.basis: Found by a MacTutor/SEP or Quanta/blogs harvest and a Wikipedia harvest (period 1990-2026); judged real by an AI verifier. events.name: Additive combinatorics as a field

Bourgain-Katz-Tao, A sum-product estimate in finite fields, GAFA 2004

events.name: Ramanujan graphs / interlacing

Marcus-Spielman-Srivastava, Interlacing families II: Kadison-Singer, Annals 2015

events.name: Khovanov homology
events.why: The Jones polynomial was lifted to a bigraded homology theory, starting a categorification programme.
works: Khovanov, A categorification of the Jones polynomial, Duke Math. J. 2000 (math/9908171)

events.name: Topological data analysis

Zomorodian-Carlsson, Computing persistent homology, DCG 2005
Carlsson, Topology and data, BAMS 2009
Carlsson et al., Scientific Reports (2013)

events.name: Unique games conjecture

The conjecture is still open, but the research area is real.

events.name: Gromov-Witten / quantum cohomology

events.name: Geometric complexity theory
